svg.title: How Pixel Visitor Village works
svg.desc: The Tistory daily count and static module initialize a Web Component, whose model drives a PixiJS Canvas inside Shadow DOM.

g.text: From a daily count to a pixel village
Calculated and drawn in the browser. No separate visitor-counting server or database.
Optional: poll the same blog HTML · 60–3600 s · off by default
Solid: default flow Dashed: optional polling Daily aggregate count; no live presence or individual identity.
